name: Western: Location Establishing Clip
description: Video preset for a location clip in the Western look.
system_prompt: Write one video prompt for a 5 second establishing shot. State the camera move, time of day, and two things moving in the scene. Keep the architecture consistent with the entity.
context_prompt: short establishing clip of the location with one slow camera move and ambient life in the frame, classic western film still, wide anamorphic frame, weathered faces, dust-caked leather and denim, sun-bleached timber, hard midday sun or golden-hour backlight, ochre and rust palette, long shadows, heat haze, slow wide establishing pans, long holds on faces, dust and tumbleweed drifting, riders small against the horizon
negative_prompt: modern vehicles, power lines, clean clothes, neon, lush green forest, text, watermark, flicker, morphing, warped faces
